summary.text: KathleenMae Rogers is a write-in candidate with no party affiliation for Missouri's 4th District. KCUR describes Rogers as a Marine Corps veteran running as an independent write-in.

paragraphs.text: KCUR describes Rogers as a Marine Corps veteran running as an independent write-in candidate; no campaign website, fundraising figures or further biographical details were found.
